package baselineobservation

import "testing"

func TestInProcessObserverCollectorFailures(t *testing.T) {
	Close()
	t.Cleanup(Close)
	if _, err := Capture(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("empty inventory reported success")
	}
	if _, err := CaptureOwner("absent"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing owner reported zero")
	}
	Register("instance_host", "panic", "fixture", func() OwnerSnapshot { panic("unreadable") })
	if _, err := Capture(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("read panic reported success")
	}
	Unregister("panic")
	Register("instance_host", "duplicate", "fixture", func() OwnerSnapshot {
		return OwnerSnapshot{Kind: "instance_host", OwnerIdentity: "duplicate", Source: "fixture", Host: &HostSnapshot{Handles: []HandleEntry{}}}
	})
	Register("instance_host", "duplicate", "fixture", func() OwnerSnapshot { return OwnerSnapshot{} })
	if _, err := Capture(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate registration reported success")
	}
	Close()
	Register("models_leases", "incomplete", "fixture", func() OwnerSnapshot {
		return OwnerSnapshot{Kind: "models_leases", OwnerIdentity: "incomplete", Source: "fixture"}
	})
	if _, err := Capture(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("incomplete owner reported success")
	}
}
